topics.title: COP31 focuses on turning pledges into action
topics.summary: Delegates at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya are debating how to convert climate commitments into practical policies, with finance, electrification and emissions cuts central to the discussions.
topics.discussionPrompt: Summits make huge promises. What practical climate change would you most like to see where you live: cleaner transit, lower energy bills, more trees, or something else?

topics.title: UK growth gets a boost from AI investment
topics.summary: Britain's economy grew 0.7% in the third quarter, with IT and professional services helping to lead the way as investment linked to artificial intelligence expanded.
topics.discussionPrompt: When new technology helps an economy grow, where should people notice it first: better jobs, useful services, lower costs, or more time for the things they enjoy?

topics.title: China approves an oral weight-loss medicine
topics.summary: China approved Eli Lilly's oral GLP-1 medicine orforglipron, making it the first weight-loss pill of its kind cleared in the country's large pharmaceutical market.
topics.discussionPrompt: New medicines can be exciting, but access matters too. What would make you feel a health breakthrough is genuinely helping everyday people?

topics.title: Fed official flags AI's workplace questions
topics.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr said the United States should prepare for possible AI-driven job disruption and widening inequality, while noting the technology may also create opportunities.
topics.discussionPrompt: If AI changed your workplace, what would you want most: training time, a say in the rollout, better tools, or a guarantee that the human parts still matter?

topics.title: India confirms ASEAN summit visit
topics.summary: India said Prime Minister Narendra Modi will attend the ASEAN summit in Manila from November 16 to 18, bringing regional trade and cooperation talks into focus.
topics.discussionPrompt: Regional summits can sound abstract. If neighboring countries teamed up on one everyday issue, would you pick travel, food, emergency planning, clean energy, or something else?

topics.title: US and China discuss future leader talks
topics.summary: US and Chinese officials said their foreign ministers discussed a constructive relationship and the importance of leader-level conversations on peace and denuclearization.
topics.discussionPrompt: When two powerful countries keep talking despite disagreements, what makes a conversation feel worthwhile: clear goals, small practical wins, public updates, or simply keeping the door open?

topics.title: Ukraine and Russia agree on prisoner exchange
topics.summary: Ukraine and Russia agreed in principle to a major prisoner exchange after talks in Abu Dhabi, though mediators said major differences remain on broader questions.
topics.discussionPrompt: A small breakthrough can matter even when bigger problems remain. What helps you keep a difficult conversation moving: patience, a practical first step, a neutral helper, or humor?

topics.title: Historic liner begins a new life as a reef
topics.summary: The retired SS United States was sunk off Florida to become an artificial reef, creating a future dive site and habitat for marine life around the former ocean liner.
topics.discussionPrompt: Giving an old ship a second life as a reef is wonderfully strange. What retired object or building would you love to see transformed for a new purpose?

topics.title: AI data centers raise energy-planning questions
topics.summary: Research highlighted proposals for AI data centers to use on-site gas power when grid connections are delayed, renewing debate over electricity demand and climate targets.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a data center wanted to open nearby, what would you want sorted out first: jobs, power use, water, local taxes, or how the community benefits?

topics.title: Markets weigh fresh AI optimism and caution
topics.summary: Technology shares helped lift global markets after CoreWeave results renewed optimism about AI demand, while investors continued to watch debt levels and lofty valuations.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a new technology gets investors excited, what keeps the excitement useful: products people love, careful budgets, independent checks, or waiting to see what endures?
